quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the impact of Darius Garland's closing performance
quotes.excerpt: Darius Garland came back in the game and really pulled us through in this game.
quotes.quote: Darius Garland came back in the game and really pulled us through in this game. I think we were down six, we brought him back, and he carried the load scoring the basketball, passing the basketball, and made some huge shots for us.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland closing out the win: Darius Garland came back in the game and really pulled us through. He carried the load scoring the basketball, passing the basketball, and made some huge shots for us.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue discusses Darius Garland's performance in the closing minutes of the game.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue praises Darius Garland's composure after early turnovers
quotes.excerpt: He had those two turnovers back to back, but after that it felt like he really willed us.
quotes.quote: He had those two turnovers back to back, but after that it felt like he really willed us to that victory. We have seen that go the other direction in a few games, so I am very proud of him that he was able to shake that off and bounce back.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland bouncing back from early turnovers: He had those two turnovers back to back, but after that it felt like he really willed us to that victory. I am very proud of him that he was able to shake that off.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue praises Darius Garland for overcoming early turnovers to help secure the win.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue discusses Derek Jones's defensive impact on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: Derek Jones was huge tonight making stuff difficult for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.
quotes.quote: Derek Jones was huge tonight making stuff difficult for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. When he went out, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander seemed like he went at everybody else but Derek Jones. He is an elite defender, and him and Darius Garland on a night-to-night basis have the toughest assignment every single night.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Derek Jones defending Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: Derek Jones was huge tonight making stuff difficult for Shai. When he went out, Shai seemed like he went at everybody else but Derek Jones. He is an elite defender.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Brook Lopez's calming presence and post play
quotes.excerpt: Brook Lopez has done a lot for us at his age and what he is able to do.
quotes.quote: Brook Lopez has done a lot for us at his age and what he is able to do by staying prepared and keeping his body right. If we need him to start, he is ready. If we need him to come off the bench, he is ready. Tonight, he was a calming presence to get the ball in the paint and for him to make some baskets that we really needed.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Brook Lopez: Brook Lopez has done a lot for us at his age. If we need him to start, he is ready. If we need him to come off the bench, he is ready. Tonight, he was a calming presence.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on Brook Lopez's veteran leadership and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: He is down there battling, getting extra possessions for us, getting and-ones, tipping the ball back to us.
quotes.quote: He is down there battling, getting extra possessions for us, getting and-ones, tipping the ball back to us, getting extra possessions like I said. But man, he has been great for us, bro. It is crazy to say this that he is 40 and playing this high of a level. This is literally his third stint of an NBA career basically. It is incredible to see, and I tip my hat to him every night.
quotes.social_post: Darius Garland on 40-year-old Brook Lopez: It is crazy to say this that he is 40 and playing this high of a level. This is literally his third stint of an NBA career basically. It is incredible to see, and I tip my hat to him every night.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on Derek Jones's defensive and offensive contributions
quotes.excerpt: He is spacing the floor for us really well. Everybody sees him dunking and flying in the air.
quotes.quote: He is spacing the floor for us really well. Everybody sees him dunking and flying in the air, his athleticism, but him stretching the floor, making the defense really got to guess a little bit with him. We run a lot of backdoors for him as well, but just keeping them on his toes and he is making step-back threes now, which is super good. It is just opening up the floor for all the guards to get downhill.
quotes.social_post: Darius Garland on Derek Jones: He is spacing the floor for us really well. Everybody sees him dunking and flying in the air, but him stretching the floor, making the defense really got to guess a little bit with him.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on Brook Lopez's energy off the bench
quotes.excerpt: Brook Lopez has been really good for us. He brings a lot of energy to our entire team.
quotes.quote: Brook Lopez has been really good for us. He brings a lot of energy to our entire team. He gives us a lot of extra possessions as well. He is super active defensively, and he is a great cutter off the ball as well, which I like a lot, especially with driving and he is just flying in, coming in for layups and even on missed shots he is getting tip-ins, tip-dunks, always running the floor.
quotes.social_post: Darius Garland on Brook Lopez: Brook Lopez has been really good for us. He brings a lot of energy to our entire team. He gives us a lot of extra possessions as well. He is super active defensively.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on his defensive mindset and foul management
quotes.excerpt: I just try my hardest to keep him on the right side of the floor.
quotes.quote: I know he likes to go left and get to his step-back, but I just try my hardest to keep him on the right side of the floor and just get a contest up. I mean, he is an MVP of this league for a reason, so we know he is going to do what he is going to do on the offensive end and try to score a lot, but for me, I just try to try to get a good contest and live with the results.
quotes.social_post: Darius Garland on defending Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: I know he likes to go left and get to his step-back, but I just try my hardest to keep him on the right side of the floor and just get a contest up.

structured.context: Darius Garland discusses his defensive approach when guarding Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on the importance of defense in the modern NBA
quotes.excerpt: I feel like for me as a defender, I don't have the leeway on the defensive end.
quotes.quote: I feel like for me as a defender, I don't have the leeway on the defensive end sometimes, but I mean, it is the game of basketball. You can't just dwell on the calls that are called, but for me personally, I just go out there and just put my best foot forward regardless. I just try to keep my man in front of me, try to keep my hands to myself.
quotes.social_post: Darius Garland on defensive officiating: I don't have the leeway on the defensive end sometimes, but it is the game of basketball. You can't just dwell on the calls that are called.

structured.context: Darius Garland talks about his mindset regarding defensive officiating and staying disciplined.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on his personal work ethic and shooting confidence
quotes.excerpt: It is just personal work. I work so hard on my game year-in, year-out, throughout the summertime.
quotes.quote: It is just personal work. I work so hard on my game year-in, year-out, throughout the summertime. I don't remember the last time I took vacation really, so it is literally season's over, I get right back in the lab. For me, that is just how I am, but yeah, it is just my work being off. I am just going to keep shooting the ball whenever they leave me open, then ball going up and they don't want to close out.
quotes.social_post: Darius Garland on his work ethic: I don't remember the last time I took vacation really, so it is literally season's over, I get right back in the lab. For me, that is just how I am.

quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on Brook Lopez's all-around impact

quotes.quote: He protects the rim at a high level and we shoot the ball at a high level. He gets to that paint and finishes under the rim layups at a high level. So it is like, I mean, he he does a lot of great things for us and and we we appreciate everything he does out there.
quotes.social_post: Darius Garland on Brook Lopez: He protects the rim at a high level and we shoot the ball at a high level. He gets to that paint and finishes under the rim layups at a high level.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on mentoring Brook Lopez
quotes.excerpt: I just to be who he is. We knew what type of player he was.
quotes.quote: I just to be who he is. We knew what type of player he was. It wasn't it wasn't no shock for us. We know he can shoot the ball, we know he can finish the ball at a high level, and whenever he get a chance he he can put the ball on the floor and create for himself and create for others. It is just it is just a game of basketball. You just got to go out there and and play confident and not let anything take your confidence away.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on his pride in playing elite defense
quotes.excerpt: I haven't yet in my career been able to be blessed to be on the all-defensive team.
quotes.quote: I haven't yet in my career been able to be blessed to be on the all-defensive team. One is because I haven't I haven't been able to be healthy all year long to to get the right amount of minutes for it, but for me that is that is my goal. I feel like every year I I contribute on the floor at a high level on the defensive end, and for me to be able to have that accolade, but just never been able to have the right amount of games for me.
